audit_result.proof_trace: Both `getAllMemberNames` and `getMemberDisplayName` enforce only authentication (`if (!user) return null`) with no `checkAdmin()` call, unlike every other admin-mutating action in the file (L425, L615, L663, L746). The `/dashboard/admin/layout.tsx` admin check is UI-render-level only; Next.js Server Actions are independently invocable POST endpoints, so any authenticated non-admin user can call `getAllMemberNames` directly with a valid session cookie, bypassing the layout guard entirely. The exposure is member real-names (本名) rather than the complete PII profile (emails, student numbers remain RLS-protected in Supabase), which limits severity.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated non-admin club member extracts the Server Action ID for `getAllMemberNames` from the client JS bundle, then POSTs directly to that endpoint with their session cookie — receiving the full uid→real-name map of all members without admin privileges.

PROP-docker-compo-pre-007.text: Complete member info aggregation exposing all PII fields must require authentication and authorization.
PROP-docker-compo-pre-007.assertion: forall complete_member_info(uid): caller.is_authenticated == true AND caller.is_authorized(uid) == true
